name: Auto Frame for Vestra Player
author: zysilm
punchline: Crops away the solid-colour border around a video's picture
description: Some videos are larger than their picture: a 2560×1440 picture in a corner of a 3840×2160 video, the rest one solid colour. Auto Frame finds the picture when a video file on this computer starts and crops the video to it, so the picture fills the window. Films with bars only above and below, or only at the sides, are left as they are. It reads a few frames of the file with the player's FFmpeg, remembers the answer per file and says on the video what it did. Video ▸ Auto Frame turns it on and off, detects again, and shows the full picture of one file.
